description.en: The RCA (phono) jack class: a centre contact behind a Ø3.5–3.6 mm opening inside an outer contact Ø8.3 mm across, taking an RCA plug. A console's composite video and audio outputs use it.
description.es: La clase de jack RCA: un contacto central detrás de una abertura de Ø3.5–3.6 mm dentro de un contacto exterior de Ø8.3 mm, que recibe un plug RCA. Las salidas de video compuesto y audio de una consola lo usan.
description.fr: La classe d'embase RCA (Cinch) : un contact central derrière une ouverture de Ø3,5–3,6 mm dans un contact extérieur de Ø8,3 mm, qui reçoit une fiche RCA. Les sorties vidéo composite et audio d'une console l'utilisent.
description.pt: A classe de jack RCA: um contato central atrás de uma abertura de Ø3,5–3,6 mm dentro de um contato exterior de Ø8,3 mm, que recebe um plugue RCA. As saídas de vídeo composto e áudio de uma consola usam-no.

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the outer contact's front face, on the jack's axis. +z points out of the jack, toward a plug; the body lies at z < 0. +x is an arbitrary radial reference: the jack is round, so the interface has continuous symmetry.

centre_opening_diameter.note: RCJ-01 draws Ø3.60 (source 2): it varies by part

interfaces.note: Female: a plug's centre pin enters the centre contact while its outer sleeve grips the outer contact. A mate puts the plug's sleeve rim on this face, a convention: no source states the seated position.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (console-hyperobjects standard-parts lane, 2026-11-01); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: IEC 60130-9, which governs the connector, is not freely published. The facts are those three jack series of one maker share; a second maker's drawing would make the class stronger. Jack insertion depth and any panel thread are not stated by the sources.
